text:
laura: Quick FYI — spotted an issue in /docs/security/audit-logs.md: the IAM audit-log query example is returning user_id for service accounts instead of identifying service_principal. Also the Go SDK snippet link at the bottom 404s. Can someone take this?

mike: Thanks, Laura. Reproduced locally. The example uses `SELECT actor_id FROM audit_events` and doesn't filter on `actor.type`. That explains why service accounts aren't surfaced. I'll open a PR to change the query to include `WHERE actor.type = 'service_principal'` and add a sample output block.

sophie: Good catch. While you're in there, can we also adjust the retention phrasing? Right now it says "we retain logs for 90 days" which could be misinterpreted for Dedicated customers. Prefer something like "default retention window is 90 days; enterprise customers may configure TTLs".

ethan: I can own the Go snippet link — looks like the path changed when we reorganized the SDK examples. I’ll update the link to point to the new package: `github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/go/examples/auditlogs`.

laura: Awesome — also please add a small note in the migration guide (docs/migration/audit-log-migration.md) about switching queries if teams previously relied on actor_id semantics. A one-line example is fine.

mike: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456 — changes: updated query to `SELECT actor_id, actor.type, payload FROM audit_events WHERE actor.type = 'service_principal' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;`, added sample JSON output, updated retention language, and fixed the Go snippet link. CI is running.

docs-bot: Build started for pull request #1456 (mike) — lint, linkcheck, spellcheck.

mike: Linkcheck failed on one internal anchor, fixing in a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: CI passed for pull request #1456 :white_check_mark:.

sophie: Reviewed and left two small wording suggestions (prefer "default window" over "default retention" in one place). LGTM after those tiny tweaks.

e than: Pushed the Go snippet link fix and updated the code example to use the new client factory. Example now shows `client.NewFromEnv()` and `client.GetAuditLogs(ctx, query)` with sample response parsing.

mike: Addressed Sophie comments, squashed commits, re-ran CI locally. All green.

laura: Merged and deployed to staging. Verified the query example in staging returns rows with `actor.type = "service_principal"` and the Go link resolves. Thanks y'all :tada:

mike: Thanks — filing a short follow-up to add an automated snippet test later so linkcheck covers example code targets.

sophie: Agreed — creating a docs issue for snippet smoke tests.

laura: Nice work, team. I'll copy the change notes into the SOC2 evidence tracker for the next control review.

e than: If anyone needs the exact sample output I used for staging verification, ping me — I'll paste it into the migration note.
